jobs.title: VP of Product & Engineering - Back of House
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

This role owns Product and Engineering for Back of House, one of the most complex, multi-service domains on the Mews platform. Back of House covers the operational core that hotel teams rely on every day, and it needs someone who can set the product direction and run the engineering behind it, together. That combined mandate, product and engineering under one person at VP level, is rare, and the scale of hospitality technology right now makes it worth doing well.

You'll own the full domain: strategy, roadmap, and the engineering org that builds it, working closely and collaboratively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, and reporting into senior leadership. This isn't a narrow platform mandate. It spans product and engineering together, with the scope to make real calls on both, and the trust to run it as one connected domain.

Back of House software has to stay reliable at all times and keep improving, without ever pausing customer delivery to get there. The next phase of this role is about applying AI directly to the systems that support hotel teams, not just internal tooling, at a scale most engineering leaders never get to work at.

What You Would Do

  • Own product and engineering strategy for Back of House end to end, across a genuinely multi-service architecture.
  • Run globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones, building the structures that let them ship together.
  • Build out a management team and develop senior ICs, growing a culture that holds up at scale.
  • Improve reliability, performance and technical debt as ongoing disciplines, without stopping delivery to do it.
  • Decide where AI genuinely belongs in the Back of House product, and ship AI-driven improvements that change how hotel teams work day to day.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
jobs.description:
Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on!

Your role

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger.

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve.

We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust

.

You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems.

Your overall responsibilities include

Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code

Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop;

Taking ownership from discovery to post-production;

Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis;

Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices

jobs.title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
jobs.description:
Who we are ?

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.  The  mainspring  of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.  The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.  A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components. jobs.title: Data Acquistion Module Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.  Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Data Acquisition Module Lead, you own how Harmattan collects the real-world sensor data that trains its onboard detection and tracking models. You run the module end to end: acquisition roadmap, sensor integration, field campaigns, and dataset quality and delivery to the computer vision and AI teams. You lead and grow a team of engineers while staying hands-on in the field. Every flight you run turns scarce test time into usable data.

Responsibilities

Turn the data needs of the computer vision and AI teams into a prioritized roadmap of collection campaigns.

Plan and run field campaigns across sensors, scenarios, environments and data volumes.

Act as single owner and point of contact for every field session assigned to the module.

Own sensor integration and calibration on aircraft and ground systems, including time synchronization and logging.

Build the pipeline from raw field capture to curated, documented and versioned datasets, with quality checks before leaving the field.

Define dataset acceptance criteria and clear handovers with the computer vision team and the annotation provider.

Arbitrate flight slots and test field access with Flight Operations and Validation to maximize usable data per flight.

Structure the team’s work, hire the profiles the module needs to grow, and mentor engineers.

Stay hands-on by operating alongside the team in the field and reporting regularly on progress, dataset coverage and gaps.

Candidate Requirements

At least 6 years of experience in sensor data collection or field testing for perception or AI systems, ideally airborne.

Hands-on experience with EO/IR, radar or comparable sensors, including synchronization, calibration, storage and metadata.

Experience running multi-person field campaigns and leading a small team.

Track record of turning a model team’s needs into a concrete data collection plan.

Piloting or flight operations exposure.

Safety-conscious, organized and pragmatic in the field, and comfortable arbitrating scarce flight time.

jobs.description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through  disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while  most German hospitals already operate at a loss .  We start where the impact is measurable from day one:  case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on  every workflow that runs a hospital , until  one agentic system handles the routine  and people decide the exceptions.  First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators,  on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us!  Why this role matters

Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital.  Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand.  That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer,  you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the  bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team .  Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn.  This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals  How the role sits in the team  You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling.  What you will do

Bring hospitals live:  You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus.

Learn from the ward:  You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements.

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?  Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten. uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine

Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle sowie ETL-/ELT-Strecken, häufig in hybriden Szenarien, in denen SAP mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio und den gängigen Cloud-Plattformen zusammenspielt.

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.  At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.  As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity  shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role  We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is curious about the modeling problem underneath cyber risk and wants to help shape a young product.  You will join OpenCRQ as its fourth engineer and work across the data model, backend and product surface. Many foundations are still being defined, giving you meaningful influence beyond the features you directly own.  You will shape these decisions with the squad and experienced engineering and product leaders across Filigran. We value constructive disagreement, clear reasoning and shared outcomes, and we expect everyone to ask for context, challenge assumptions and learn from one another.

🧩 The problem you would be working on  Ask a CISO what a cyber risk could cost, and the answer often still begins with a color: red, amber or green, often produced by a spreadsheet disconnected from current evidence.  OpenCRQ replaces that color with a financial estimate and a traceable chain of evidence: which threat actors are active, which assets they can reach, which controls have proven effective and what the remaining exposure could cost.  Every step is computed from live data and must withstand a simple question from a board: “Where does that figure come from?” That is what makes this an engineering problem rather than a reporting one.  OpenCRQ is Filigran’s cyber risk quantification product. It combines threat intelligence from OpenCTI, exposure and control validation from OpenAEV, and agentic workflows through XTM One. As these products become more connected, the squad will define what agents can ask of the risk model, which evidence they can use and how their answers remain safe and explainable.

End-to-end product ownership.  Take product problems from early ideation and technical design through implementation, end-to-end testing and validation with users. You will have the autonomy to drive the work,

By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a talented Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Storage and Messaging team in our established Platform Engineering team.  We are an exchange. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality

Build a self-service platform that empowers teams to build at scale across diverse database and messaging technologies, enabling the seamless and reliable development of application and data products.

Continuously evolve our platform to support new data models and use cases, including structured and semi-structured data models, stream processing, and data governance at scale .

Mentor teammates by sharing technical knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and driving engineering excellence.

Experience with one or more programming languages. We primarily use Golang and Python (Java is a plus), but we value problem-solving ability over syntax familiarity.

Strong understanding of platform engineering principles and distributed data systems.

jobs.title: Principal Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We're hiring a Principal Compliance Associate to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.

The opportunity

Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

What you bring

Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we’re building the trust layer for how the world’s most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We’re turning the function that has always said “no” into infrastructure that says “yes, and here’s how.”  This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we’re only at the beginning. The product you’ll help build is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.  Founded in 2024, we’ve already earned the trust of leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, NatWest, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise £2.6m in funding, and we’re now scaling fast. We’re building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product engineering role for someone who has shipped real features and wants to take on more ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers and the founders on product slices from spec to production. Over time you’ll own them end-to-end. Here’s the kind of work you’ll contribute to:

A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. It was built with Monzo as the design partner and is public on the Chrome Web Store.

A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, and the action runs.

The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

Integrations that reach into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront,  Monday.com , and  Frame.io  for video.

A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day and tell us quickly when something’s wrong. That tight feedback loop is one of the best things about the job, and it’s a fast way to grow.

What you’ll do

Ship product features from spec to production. Most of the work is across the full stack, and integration work where needed. You’ll start with guidance and take on bigger slices as you grow.

Build the surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, and the moments where model output meets human judgement.

Work on features where AI is in the critical path. The model is genuinely part of the product, not bolted on.

Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first few weeks. We deploy continuously, so you’ll feel the pace immediately.

Bring your perspective to what we build and how we build it. We want to hear when something does

jobs.title: Director Customer Growth (all gender)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an  Director Customer Growth (all gender)  to join our  Customer Success Team  at our office in  Berlin . Join us in building the AI-driven financial operating system for European healthcare!  What to expect in the role as  Director Customer Growth:  As Director Customer Growth, you own growth across our existing customer base. You lead a team of 8–10 Key Account Managers, report to our VP Customer Success and work closely with our executive leadership team.  The role has two phases.  First, transformation:  you turn a team with a strong service identity into a commercial growth unit with its own pipeline, reliable forecasting and measurable expansion numbers.  Then, scale:  you design a scalable tech-touch model for our 2,000+ smaller practices.  You are not only a manager but also hands-on in deals: with large practice chains, you lead the conversations at C-level.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, taking admin, billing and payments off practices plates so they can focus on patients. We combine what banks and practice software offer separately: factoring, payments and software in one platform. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why?  Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart:  We hire exceptional people and hold each other to the highest standards. We believe in talent density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. We invest heavily in your development: a learning budget, regular feedback and room to take on more. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

Own net revenue retention:  You own NRR across our customer base, from activation after onboarding to expansion and retention; and the forecast to leadership.

Activate new practices:  You shorten the time it takes newly onboarded practices to reach their full Private Factoring volume and AI usage.

Retain and grow strategic accounts:  You manage our largest chains proactively, so risk is spotted early and churn does not concentrate in a few accounts.

Drive expansion:  You carry the upsell and cross-sell targets across our portfolio (factoring, payments, software).

Build the growth motion:  You design the funnel, pipeline stages, playbooks, tooling and enablement.

Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.  About AMBOSS  AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our

video

to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?  Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

At

TYTAN

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on

Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems

to join the Core team within our Platform Team. Everything we build is a node: from small embedded devices to full compute systems and ground infrastructure. Together they operate as one network, in the field and over denied, degraded and intermittent links. You design how this works end to end: how nodes find and connect to each other, how trust propagates, how they communicate, and how every node exposes what the application stack needs. And you build it: the network itself, the node agent that runs on every node, the node API and the SDK.

Your roadmap to make an impact

System design:

Own the end-to-end design of how our systems connect and communicate: topology, links, transports, delivery semantics and failure behaviour. When a new requirement lands, such as operating a system beyond line of sight over LEO satellite or cellular links, you design how it works: latency budget, link selection and failover, security, and what keeps working when the link drops

The network:

Build it: addressing plans, routing, segmentation and multi-homing across tactical radio, cellular, satcom and wired links, with dynamic routing and link selection for nodes that move and links that fail

Secure links:

IPsec/IKEv2 or WireGuard overlays with certificate authentication from hardware-backed keys, including rekeying, NAT traversal and behaviour on link loss

Trust:

Design how trust propagates from production to the field: device identity, certificate lifecycle, mutual authentication, authorisation tiers, revocation and signed commands that keep working without backend connectivity

Node agent:

Design and build the agent that runs on every node and exposes identity, health, software state, connectivity and updates through one API, served locally, over the network and in compact form over constrained links. Devices too small to run it are represented through their parent node

Node API and SDK:

One resource model for every node type, versioned and backward compatible across a fleet that never updates all at once, with SDKs generated from the contract for the languages our teams use

Discovery and directory:

How nodes find each other with and without infrastructure

Founding Full-Stack Engineer  Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.  The opportunity  Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.  We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.  About us  planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.  What you'll own

The product layer:  Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

Backend and data:  Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

Interfaces and visualization:  Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

Integration:  Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

Infrastructure:  Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

The team:  Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement. We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve. Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Du baust lieber Datenplattformen, denen das Management vertraut, als Dashboards, die nach drei Wochen keiner mehr öffnet? Du sprichst SQL, Python und DAX genauso fließend wie die Sprache des Controllings? Dann lass uns reden.

Wir suchen genau dich, wenn du Datenprojekte von der Quelle bis zum Management-Dashboard verantwortest. Nicht nur Pipelines, nicht nur Reports, sondern das Ganze, mit sauberem Datenmodell in der Mitte.

Pexon Consulting baut Cloud- und KI-Plattformen für große Unternehmen und den gehobenen Mittelstand im DACH-Raum. Seit 2020 haben wir über 400 Projekte umgesetzt, für mehr als 100 Kunden. Wir sind Partner von AWS, Microsoft Azure und Google Cloud und nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Unser Versprechen: Bankqualität und KI auf Kubernetes.  Du arbeitest in unserem Bereich Data & AI mit Schwerpunkt Analytics. Du baust für unsere Kunden Lakehouse- und Warehouse-Lösungen auf Microsoft Fabric und SQL Server und machst daraus Reporting, mit dem Fachbereich und Geschäftsführung wirklich steuern.

Deine Aufgaben

Plattformen bauen: Du konzipierst und baust Lakehouse- und Warehouse-Architekturen in Microsoft Fabric, mit OneLake, Data Factory und Notebooks.

Daten modellieren: Du entwirfst Star-Schemas, baust ETL/ELT-Pipelines und sorgst dafür, dass die Datenqualität stimmt.

Reporting, das genutzt wird: Du entwickelst Power-BI-Reports und semantische Modelle mit DAX, Power Query und Row-Level Security.

Datenbanken im Griff: Du integrierst und optimierst SQL Server, Azure SQL und PostgreSQL.

Nah am Fachbereich: Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, definierst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden KPIs und Reports und übergibst die Lösung sauber an den Kunden.

Als Senior oder Lead: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und, je nach Erfahrung, für fachliche Führung im Projekt.

Was wir dir bieten

Projekte, die Spaß machen: Wir arbeiten an richtig spannenden Data- und KI-Projekten für namhafte Kunden aus Energie, Industrie und Finanzen.

Moderner Stack: Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI und Azure. Du arbeitest mit Technologien, die gerade gefragt sind, und nicht an Altlasten.

Wirkung sehen: Deine Dashboards landen beim Management. Du siehst, dass deine Arbeit Entscheidungen beeinflusst.

Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Principals zusammen. Ideen werden schnell entschieden und umgesetzt.

Entwicklung: Wer mitzieht, wächst mit, in Verantwortung, Projekten und Team. Zertifizierungen wie DP-600 oder DP-700 unterstützen wir.

Flexibilität: Du arbeitest von zu Hause oder in unseren Büros in Berlin oder München

Erfahrung: 4 bis 7 Jahre als Data Engineer, BI- oder Analytics Engineer, idealerweise in Kundenprojekten.

Plattform: Du hast praktische Projekterfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric und/oder Databricks.

Power BI: Du bringst mehrere Jahre Projekterfahrung mit Power BI mit, inklusive DAX und Datenmodellierung.

Modellierung: Dimensionale Modellierung und ETL/ELT-Design sind dein Handwerk.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Graphics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer. This role can be based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, Spain or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS).

  • Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD.

  • Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR).

  • Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers.

  • Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance.

  • Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers.

  • Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs.

  • Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms.

  • Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms.

  • Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code.

  • Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs.

  • Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Graphics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer. This role can be based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, Spain or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS).

  • Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD.

  • Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR).

  • Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers.

  • Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance.

  • Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers.

  • Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs.

  • Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms.

  • Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms.

  • Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code.

  • Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs.

  • Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs.

jobs.title: Director, Product MONOPOLY GO!
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director of Product Performance to serve and elevate our new casual game, Monopoly GO!, in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

What You Will Do

The Director of Product, Performance will lead a diverse team of performance product managers, economy designers, and analysts. Your mission will be to drive performant and innovative Live Operations, monetization strategy, and long-term roadmap execution, ensuring engaging, innovative experiences for players.

This role involves working across many cross-functional teams to optimize in-game events, content, and sales while setting and achieving weekly and monthly KPI and revenue goals.

  • Lead the scheduling and execution of Monopoly GO’s calendar of live events, offers, and content updates to enhance player experience, keep the game fresh and engaging, and drive revenue growth.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a cross-functional team of performance product managers, economy designers, and analysts.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to define the vision, culture, and processes that make Scopely an industry leader in mobile F2P gaming.
  • Shape the long-term roadmap by aligning product needs, organizational goals, and strategic objectives.
  • Forecast weekly and monthly KPI targets and develop strategies to achieve or surpass them.
  • Monitor and analyze key metrics and user feedback in real-time to identify trends, optimize the game economy, and address any concerns.
  • Use quantitative insights (Analytics team), qualitative feedback (Community, CS), and competitive analysis to continually refine and improve the player experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience defining monetization strategies for casual F2P games.
  • Hands-on experience with live operations for mobile F2P games.
  • Strong background in forecasting and delivering on revenue and key performance metrics for live games.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Riot Games Communications team works across games, esports, and entertainment to tell compelling stories, build trust with our communities, and create meaningful moments for players around the world.

In EMEA, the League of Legends Regional Communications team brings those stories to life across a diverse media landscape, working closely with global teams, regional stakeholders, local markets, and agency partners.

jobs.title: Product Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next  is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. jobs.title: Trading Manager
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.  Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.  We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.  We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.  Where we are today:

Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

$90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

You think like a trader.  You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

You want to win.  You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

You act fast.  You decide and follow up.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.  Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.  Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world

You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals

Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey

Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent

YOUR IMPACT

Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform : we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront : we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic has done pioneering work examining the economic impacts of AI. The AI & Rule of Law team takes an analogous approach to a different question: how will AI affect our constitutional democratic institutions?

Increasingly powerful AI systems will put pressure on societal functions at every level — the courts, legislatures, electoral systems, oversight bodies, and the legal frameworks that hold democratic governance together. Our team exists to ask hard questions about those vulnerabilities, and to seek out strategies for protecting democratic freedoms — in the short and long term, through both technical and policy levers.

This is early, high-stakes research. The team is small, the problems are genuinely unsolved, and the work will matter.

We are looking for someone with deep expertise in both AI and at least one of: government, political science, or public policy. The ideal candidate understands the technical landscape well enough to reason about AI capabilities and risks, and understands democratic institutions well enough to see where those risks become structural threats.

We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Drone Software Engineer to join a swarming programme. As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects.

You will not be siloed; this role spans the entire autonomy lifecycle, from developing autonomy capabilities to investigating real-world flight-test data.

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across the autonomy stack and partner integrations
  • Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners to define system requirements and translate them into robust software architecture
  • Design and implement robust distributed state machines, leader election protocols, and fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code while confidently managing complex concurrency and contention scenarios
  • Develop and run rigorous tests utilizing SITL/HITL simulation environments to validate code prior to physical deployment
  • Actively participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical documentation to elevate the team's engineering standards
  • Act decisively during flight-test investigations, applying strong engineering judgment to physical failure modes and release safety

Qualifications and Skills

  • 3+ years of professional engineering experience in robotics, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
  • Deep proficiency in modern C++, with practical experience designing, reasoning about, and debugging highly concurrent systems.
  • Embedded systems experience working close to hardware on real-time or safety-critical platforms (e.g., avionics, automotive, robotics).
  • Strong architectural understanding of distributed systems, with the ability to deliberately evaluate and select consensus designs.
  • Familiarity with robust release management, versioned artifacts, and pinned dependencies.
  • Experience with PX4, MAVLink, and related drone software ecosystems is a plus
  • EU citizenship required

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan
  • Car parking
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support

jobs.title: Front End Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.  Where we are:

Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

$4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.  You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.  What we're actually screening for:

You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

What We're Looking For

Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

Can set direction and still go deep into details.

Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

This Role Is Not For

Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

People who cannot go deep into product details.

As a member of this team, you will work to execute thoughtful, data-driven marketing campaigns that drive meaningful growth for the company.

You will also develop the creative testing roadmap and leverage incrementality to measure performance. This role reports to the AVP of Growth.

We expect AI fluency in practice. As targeting, bidding, and placement have moved inside the platforms’ models, creative has become the main lever you control. Leveraging AI tools for strategic research and automating operations will be key to success. Much of our process is being automated through internal AI workflows, so this role will have more emphasis on workflow oversight.

In this role, you will:

Run day-to-day paid social and video across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube: campaign build, budget pacing, audience and placement setup, and optimization against incrementality KPIs.

Plan and execute the creative testing roadmap — write briefs, launch tests, experiment readouts.

Leverage AI tools (Claude, Gemini, internal workflows) for strategic research and operations. You'll partner closely with the AVP of Growth to continually develop and improve AI workflows.

Build and maintain the weekly and monthly creative performance marketing reports.

Partner with Brand and Creative on asset needs, turning performance reads into specific, useful creative direction.

Run structured tests — holdouts, geo splits, incrementality reads — supporting the AVP of Growth, and interpret the results honestly against platform-reported numbers.

Flag new formats, placements, and platform features worth testing, and make the case for trying them.

Incrementality.  To truly understand the performance of our efforts, we rely on incrementality methods, such as geolift. We then leverage platform metrics as multipliers based on the measurement outcomes for daily operational KPIs.

Creative performance.  Leverage platform metrics to build creative narratives to explain how they performed and what we should do next.

Operational reliability.  Campaigns should launch accurately and on time. With AI automated more operations, this person must be have final oversight before campaigns launch.

3+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and/or YouTube Ads.

Experience with incrementality and/or MMM to measure true lift or causal performance.

Comfort working in performance data — pivot tables, dashboards, and enough rigor to catch a number that looks wrong before it reaches a deck.

You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. The Agent Infra team builds the infrastructure that runs autonomous AI agents at Roblox for millions of creators building experiences on our platform, and for thousands of Roblox engineers shipping production code every day.

Agent workloads break the assumptions most infrastructure is built on. Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Ads Measurement team, you will architect and build foundational ads systems that are capable of reliably serving Roblox’s massive scale. You will drive performance improvements to our ads serving and delivery infrastructure, while expanding our systems to support a variety of new and immersive ads experiences. Your scope will span across multiple teams and require close collaboration with engineers across ML, backend, and analytics to shape the future of ads infrastructure at Roblox.

If you're passionate about large-scale data processing, sophisticated ad measurement & audience system, and privacy-enhancing ad technologies, this role offers unparalleled technical challenges. You will directly impact business outcomes and redefine how brands connect with audiences within the immersive metaverse, shaping the future of advertising.

This position will report to our Senior Engineering Manager and require you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA Tuesdays to Thursdays.

You Will:

  • Build and ship best-in-class Ads products used by hundreds of millions of users.
  • Develop backend services that scale to billions of products and transactions.
  • Design and implement sophisticated attribution models and identity matching solutions that operate at scale, providing advertisers with a holistic view of their campaigns performance.
  • Develop seamless integration with various 3rd-party measurement partners to offer comprehensive insights such as view-ability, brand safety, audience reach and audience verification.
  • Develop and optimize audience segmentation and management systems (demographic, interest, behavioral, lookalike) that empower advertisers to reach their desired audiences with precision.
  • Be a tech lead and mentor junior engineers
  • Self-organize and take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycle.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.
  • Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
  • Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.
  • Experience with large-scale data or analytical

As a Senior Privacy Engineer on the Security and Privacy GRC team, you will shepherd and grow Roblox's Privacy Review Program, the technical and process backbone that ensures privacy is engineered into every product before it ships. You will join the Security and Privacy GRC team, reporting to the Sr Engineering Manager for Privacy Governance and Operations. This is a hands-on privacy engineering role: you'll set standards for privacy-enhancing technologies, act as the go-to SME for policy-as-code, and partner closely with Product teams, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Regulatory Compliance as part of Roblox's broader cross-functional privacy program.

  • Drive privacy-by-design adoption across product and engineering organizations through self-service tooling, consultation, and scalable enablement programs.

jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours.
The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast.

As our  ML Runtime Engineer , you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon.

About this role:

Own model compilation: turn partner  ONNX  models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets

Build the ground-side compile & delivery path; define how a mismatched engine is detected/rejected on-node

Build performance tooling: benchmarking, profiling, operator-coverage matrices, and budget validation

Contribute to Space Inference Engine (execution providers) and the SDK (model build & packaging); coordinate the  OBSW  / Runtime team

Must Haves:

Strong C++ and Python

Model compilation: TensorRT (and/or equivalent graph compilers)

ONNX  Runtime, quantization & inference perf optimization

Embedded / edge GPU deployment ( NVIDIA  Jetson)

Benchmarking & profiling / perf tooling

CI/CD incl. hardware-in-the-loop

Nice to Haves:

Hailo SDK and/or AMD ROCm compilation (iX10)

Writing custom kernels / operator plugins

Remote sensing / large-image handling

RF  /  IQ  signal data exposure

Meson build, Yocto / minimal Debian images

Model-weight protection / secure execution

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:

Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success

Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best

Health and life insurance, we care about your health

Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it  #loft-gourmand )

Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences

Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together

Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

Mindset

Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une  vision , une  stratégie claire , et une  gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte.

composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent

Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence.

Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit
