Aligner Design et Engineering en continu  : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production.

Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes  : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits.

Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs  : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Shop
jobs.description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets.

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.

What you'll be doing

Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business

Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines

Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

What you'll need

3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership

Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend

You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt

jobs.title: Entrepreneur Intern
jobs.description:
About SeeSicht Gmbh  SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds.  Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh  You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment.  What you will do

You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes.

You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend.

MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects.

Current projects: Fairbroker.ch (AI insurance broker, market test now, live Q1 2027), a kettlebell workout app (52-card deck, early prototype, suppliers in China secured), and Glanzio (B2B store-window cleaning, launch test Q1 2027).

The timeline — how it works

Months 1–12 — the internship:  CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on.

From month 13 — the stake:  the internship is over and you get a stake in the company, up to 10% equity, with a base salary of at least CHF 5,000/month — plus the up to 10% profit share on top. If a project becomes a real company, a senior position is possible, depending on how you develop.

What you get from day 1

All the AI tools

A company laptop

A place to work and a structure from day 1

Me, coaching and strategising side by side with you

Who we're looking for (requirements)

You're finishing or just finished university.

Two of these skills are genuinely strong, the rest you understand and want to grow: marketing, operations/service design, design, UX, AI usage.

You work the way we work: Lovable, Claude and Airtable — that's the whole stack. If something is missing, you say why and it gets added.

You're transparent, fast and smart.

jobs.title: Hydrus - Session Director - Spanish (Mexico) - V2
jobs.description:
About the Project

Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products — voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances.

As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment — making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace.

What You'll Do

Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation.

Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally.

Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed.

Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise.

Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes.

Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience.

What We're Looking For

Required

Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing.

Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction).

Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction.

Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels).

Comfortable improvising and adjusting scripted material on the spot.

Excellent interpersonal skills; able to build rapport quickly with performers of varying experience levels.

Preferred (nice to have, not required)

Background in improv, theater direction, or acting coaching.

Experience directing non-professional or first-time voice talent specifically.

Familiarity with DAWs or recording software (e.g., Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Reaper) for spot-checking audio quality.

Commitment & Compensation

Estimated time: Approximately 8 hours calibration, plus supervision across two recording sessions of ~4 hours each per participant

Work Type - Freelance Remote

Rate: $55.00 USD per hour

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Kestra  Kestra is the  universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.  Trusted by  over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including  JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to  30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.  About the role  Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
 You would be our first dedicated security hire.  We're looking for a  Senior Security Engineer  to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
 This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do  Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

Conduct hands-on penetration testing  and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments.

Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking  across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure.

Proactively fix security flaws  by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation.

Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure  (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats.

Automate security tooling  into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production.

Perform security code reviews  and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks.

Lead incident response  efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies.

Own our public security posture  as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem.

Our Tech Stack

Security & Vulnerability Tools : Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security

Infrastructure : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

Cloud : GCP

Programming language : Java, Typescript, Javascript

About Winton

Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. The firm researches and trades quantitative investment strategies, which are implemented systematically via thousands of securities, spanning the world's major liquid asset classes. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors.

We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management.

Our Technology

Operating in a cloud-first environment, we predominantly write our backend systems in C# but otherwise make pragmatic choices for each scenario. This often means Python with C++ employed in performance-sensitive cases.

Our applications are written with containerisation in mind from the outset and deployed as a Docker image into Kubernetes on AWS where we can scale on-demand to satisfy burstable workloads. We make extensive use of Kafka for low-latency communication across applications and use a mixture of different technologies for storage, from S3 to relational databases.   • Collaborate with the team through active contribution in code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and design discussions.
  • Write and maintain good quality, well-tested code across services, data storage and UI layers.

What we're Looking For:

  • A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent technical field.
  • 2+ years of professional software

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social.  Vibe.co  is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co  is an  Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform  that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use  Vibe.co  to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026,  Vibe.co  became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe.  With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow. As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
jobs.description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program.

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems.

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.

Reddit  is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit  www.redditinc.com .

Reddit is a complex consumer ecosystem where users, content, communities, and conversations interact over time. We are looking for a very senior data science thought leader to shape how Reddit understands and improves that ecosystem for the user / consumer flywheel.

This role will define the measurement, modeling, and experimentation strategy for major Consumer questions: how users discover value, form habits, and deepen engagement; how we understand and serve user intent; how content and communities evolve; and how our systems create durable value for users, contributors, communities, and Reddit.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more areas of consumer science, such as:

Recommender systems and information retrieval

User modeling, personalization, lifecycle, LTV, or optimization

Content, community, or ecosystem modeling

Knowledge graphs and representations of users, content, and communities

Causal inference, experimentation, and long-term consumer measurement

You will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Research, and Community to turn ambiguous consumer problems into clear scientific questions, durable analytical systems, and decisions that improve Reddit at scale.

Set the scientific direction for high-impact Consumer problems spanning discovery, relevance, personalization, user growth, retention, content, and communities.

Ensure coherence around ecosystem interactions including feedback loops, selection effects, interference, distribution shift, content supply, and other ecosystem risks.

Translate complex technical findings into clear product and business decisions.

Develop exceptional scientists through mentoring and influence data science org health and direction

This dual-location role is all about driving impact. You'll analyze data, help identify opportunities, and support strategies that redefine the grocery shopping experience across Europe. Throughout this year-long program, you’ll exchange between two locations Paris (6 months) and Amsterdam (6 months), gaining cross-market perspectives in a fast-paced environment.

Tricks of the trade

  • Solving real-life puzzles: Tackle critical business questions that shape Picnic’s business model every day.
  • Enabling: Achieve operational excellence by approaching challenges with a data-driven and analytical mindset.
  • Building: Create and optimize models for real-time improvements.
  • Communicating: Work effectively with different teams to deliver impactful and sustainable solutions.
  • Owning your projects: Take initiative by challenging the status-quo. Just because it’s been done that way doesn’t mean it’s the best way. Try us!

Your superpowers

  • You are currently pursuing a Master’s in a Quantitative field
  • You have experience with SQL and Python or similar programming languages
  • You are able to hold fluent presentations both in English and French
  • You have an EU citizenship
  • You are available for 12 months

Depending on your Internship performance, we can discuss further opportunities for a full-time role at Picnic!

Picnic Perks

💪Every expert was once a beginner!
 You’ll get plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself and grow, including the Picnic Tech Academy, Lunch & Learn sessions, and tailored soft skills training. We also offer free professional weekly language courses.

🧑‍🎓Make a difference
You’ll work in an awesome scaleup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact. Our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place!

🎓Teamwork makes the dream work
With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings to after-work drinks to our company ski trip and more!

📌Attractive package
We offer a gross salary of €1,500 per month in Paris

jobs.title: Strategy - Future Leaders Graduate Program
jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Du kommst frisch aus dem Studium und bist bereit, direkt ins Herz unseres Businesses einzusteigen? Komplexe Challenges schrecken dich nicht ab - sondern motivieren dich erst recht? Dann gehörst du ins Consumer Team von Picnic. Unser 1-jähriges Trainee Programm ist kein Warm-up, sondern dein echtes Launchpad. Du startest direkt ohne Rotation in einer Consumer-Rolle - ob Category Management, Store, Meals oder Customer, je nachdem wo deine Stärken und Interessen liegen.

Ab Tag eins arbeitest du mit echten Daten, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Projekte voran, die sichtbar Impact haben. Parallel dazu investieren wir gezielt in dich: mit Trainings zu Marktverständnis, Business-Knowledge und Präsentations-Skills.

Und weil Erfolg gemeinsam mehr Spaß macht, wirst du Teil einer eng vernetzten Graduate-Community - smart, ambitioniert und immer bereit, Dinge neu zu denken.

Kurz gesagt: Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern deinen Berufseinstieg aktiv mitgestalten willst - Welcome to Picnic!

Das erwartet dich

  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit unseren Category Managern, Designern, Copywritern und Tech-Teams bringst du alle Köpfe an einen Tisch. Das Ergebnis: ein App-Erlebnis, das nicht nur reibungslos funktioniert, sondern unsere Kunden begeistert.
  • Analyse: Zahlen sind dein Kompass. Aus Kundenverhalten leitest du smarte Insights ab, verbesserst App-Features, schärfst unser Pricing und entwickelst Aktionen, die einfach überzeugen.
  • Innovation: Du denkst einen Schritt weiter. Trends und Kundenbedürfnisse erkennst du früh und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Sortiment ständig weiterentwickelt.
  • Optimierung: Mit einem Blick fürs Detail entwickelst du Tools und Prozesse, die unsere kommerziellen Aktivitäten effizienter, präziser und wirkungsvoller machen.
  • Projekte: Du steuerst cross-funktionale Projekte - von Marketing über Customer Experience bis hin zu Operational Excellence. Immer mit dem Ziel, Wachstum voranzutreiben und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im MINT-Bereich (z.B. Ingenieurwesen, Physik, Mathematik, Ökonometrie) oder im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften (z. B. Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft)

jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Bei Picnic betreiben wir einige der modernsten teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) für Lebensmittel Europas - mit einer Mischung aus Robotik, smarter Software und einer People-First-Kultur. Mit über 3.000 EPVs (Electric Picnic Vehicle) liefern wir in über 100 deutschen Städten täglich Lebensmittel aus. Unsere jüngste Investment Runde, an der auch die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation beteiligt ist, zeigt das Vertrauen in unser Konzept. Als Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d) in unserem FC in Falkensee spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Zufriedenheit unserer KundInnen und Mitarbeitenden.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

  • Wertstromanalyse: Du leitest Wertstromanalysen zur Ermittlung des Ist-Zustandes von Prozessen, analysierst wertschöpfende und nicht wertschöpfende Tätigkeiten und entwickelst Pläne für den Soll-Zustand, um Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben.

  • Datenanalyse: Mit ausgeprägter Datenanalyse- und Problemlösungskompetenz identifizierst und behebst du Prozessprobleme.

  • Teamleitung: Mit natürlichen Führungsqualitäten förderst du Bottom-up-Engagement und die tägliche Einbindung der Produktionsstätten und Mitarbeitenden, um Kaizen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voranzutreiben.

jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Nürnberg bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.


Das erwartet dich

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 4 Teamleitenden und über 50 Lagermitarbeitenden.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für Schichtarbeit (inklusive Abenden und Samstagen) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.

jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short,  we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are looking for a

Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert,

to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Working at the intersection of research and software development you will translate state-of-the-art research into reliable simulation capabilities that support device design and development.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

Research the literature on state-of-the-art approaches to graphene device modeling and simulation

Work with commercial TCAD and multiphysics simulation tools

Translate physical models from scientific literature into robust, maintainable Python code

Develop and extend models for graphene-based photonic devices, incorporating new physical effects and functionalities

Calibrate, validate, and refine models using experimental characterization data

Collaborate closely with various teams, prioritizing modeling activities in line with team and company goals

Document your work clearly and contribute to shared software-development practices

Your Qualifications

PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Strong foundation in solid-state physics, semiconductor physics, and mathematics

Proficient in modeling techniques and methodologies for semiconductor physics

Proven ability to translate scientific literature and mathematical models into simulation code

Experience with TCAD development

Proficiency in Python and Git

Experience solving partial differential equations, particularly for charge and heat transport

Experience with graphene and photonics

Experience with commercial simulation tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or Ansys Lumerical is a plus

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About us  People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.  Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.  Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role  We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.  You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.  Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

Product:  You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

AI:  You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. About the role  Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it. What you’ll be doing

Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

What you’ll need

An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Own the Holistic Lead & Pipeline Lifecycle:  Design, optimize, and oversee the full demand funnel from initial buyer signal to Closed-Won deal. Bridge the gap between HubSpot Marketing automation, Salesloft cadences, and Salesforce CRM to eliminate lead leakage and friction.

Operationalize Our 2026 ICP & Intent Signals:  Hardwire our target ICP criteria, EU mid-market organizations with 500–5,000 employees in regulated industries (Manufacturing, Healthcare, Finance, Public Sector), into our lead scoring and routing logic. Use Clay and Zapier to enrich accounts based on Microsoft 365 tech stack indicators and regulatory pressure signals (e.g., NIS2, DORA compliance deadlines).

Supercharge SDR & AE Outbounding:  Build automated prospecting workflows that allow SDRs and AEs to discover, enrich, and add target ICP contacts into Salesloft cadences with one click.

Channel Efficiency & Attribution:  Track and optimize lead-to-opportunity conversion metrics across all GTM motions. Capitalize on data showing that AE-sourced pipeline yields significantly higher win rates than traditional cold marketing leads, using insights to reallocate GTM focus dynamically.

Introduce AI-Native Lead Generation:  Partner with our dedicated GTM Engineer to implement cutting-edge AI use cases across the top of the funnel. Drive automated lead enrichment, intent-based account prioritization, and automated meeting scheduling to maximize representative output per hour.

Pipeline Health & Target Setting:  Partner with Marketing Leadership, Sales Leadership, and the Revenue Operations team to set MQL/SQL targets, track funnel velocity, and maintain a robust unweighted pipeline coverage ratio of 3-4x across all territories.

What You Bring (requirements)

Experience:  5+ years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or Sales Operations within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Holistic GTM Perspective:  You view demand generation as a single team

jobs.description:
1Password  is growing.  We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We're hiring a Senior Developer Advocate to be the face and voice of 1Password's developer story — especially our push into  identity and access control for AI agents . You'll build hands-on demos and videos that show developers exactly how to use 1Password, carry that content into a genuine presence on Reddit and X, grow the community around it, and represent 1Password on stage at major developer conferences.

You'll report to the Director of Developer Relations as an individual contributor.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

Build demos and videos.  Hands-on, code-first demos and short-form videos showing developers how to use 1Password — particularly for securing AI agents, service accounts, and machine identities.

Build a social presence.  Own and grow 1Password's developer voice on  Reddit, Youtube and X  — daily posting, engaging in threads, answering questions, participating authentically in developer communities.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs  provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be the embedded AI automation engineer for Product, building the agents, automations, and apps that help product managers, product marketers, and designers move faster. You work directly with them, and with engineering, across the product lifecycle from early discovery through launch and adoption. You sit inside the teams, not behind a ticket queue.

Move repetitive, manual work into agents and automations so Product, Product Marketing, and Design spend their time on judgment and customer work, not busywork.

Give teams direct access to customer insight and the data behind it through the tools you build, so they make better-informed decisions.

Ship agentic solutions teams actually adopt, so the same headcount operates at a scale it otherwise could not.

Turn a rough idea into a working prototype in hours and ship same-day production fixes to shared agents, driving faster speed to market across Product and Marketing.

Strong software engineering in Python or TypeScript. You ship production code, not just workflows wired together.

Judgment about where AI adds value and where it does not.

Globally distributed, fully remote, and async-first.

Roughly a 6 hour overlap with 8:00am to 5:00pm PST.

Embedded side by side with the teams you serve, with a connection back to the AI Automation team and engineering.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Communications
jobs.description:
Background

Nash  is a logistics AI company that moves real things in the real world. Our platform plans, dispatches and adjusts deliveries for brands like Walmart, 7-Eleven, Ahold Delhaize and Square, and every decision it makes ends with groceries, prescriptions or a dinner order arriving at someone's door. It already dispatches to drones and autonomous vehicles alongside human drivers, through partners like Flytrex and Autolane. Most AI stories play out on a screen. Ours plays out in stores, on streets and at front doors, which makes it more consequential, harder to explain, and a far better story when it's told well.

We're backed by a16z and Y Combinator, and a new category is forming around what we do: autonomic logistics, meaning systems that plan, run and improve delivery operations continuously on their own. We're hiring our first Head of Corporate Communications to make sure Nash is the company telling that story.

The Role

You'll own how Nash is understood by everyone outside a sales conversation: press, analysts, our own team, our customers' executives and the wider market. You'll report to our Chief Growth Officer (Twilio, Plaid, Salesforce) and work closely with our CEO on his external voice, alongside a small, senior, fast-moving team. We're not looking for someone to write press releases on request. We want the person who gets the market to understand a category before it has a Magic Quadrant.

What We're Looking For

Editorial judgment. You know the difference between something we'd like to announce and something a reporter wants to write about, and you can find the second inside the first.

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at  Customer.io . We're looking for a staff product engineer — not a generalist who happens to touch frontend and backend, but someone who thinks like a product owner and ships like an engineer.

About  Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day.  Customer.io  powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

End-to-end ownership

You take on the problems nobody's claimed — the ones that span squads with no obvious owner — and carry them from a fuzzy first conversation to what's actually live. If it touches the customer, it's yours to chase down.

Comfort in ambiguity

Half-formed problems and conflicting signals are your starting material, not a blocker. You define the problem before you solve it, form a point of view on what's worth building, and move without waiting for someone else to de-risk the call.

Customer-first, always

You think from the customer's problem backward, not the codebase forward. Every technical call traces back to what it does for the person on the other end of the message — and you can explain that connection to people who don't write code. Given the choice, you ship the thing that changes their experience, not the thing that's merely elegant.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"

You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication

Shipping your part isn't the bar. You bring in the right people before a problem becomes theirs to clean up, and you leave enough behind — docs, patterns, delegation — that the team keeps moving without you in the room.

What You'll Do

Own important, ambiguous problems from initial framing through launch and iteration. Set direction, align partners, and stay accountable for the result.

Partner with product, design, and data to shape priorities, scope the work, and define how success will be measured.

Lead technical decisions across the stack, including architecture, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Lead work across teams and systems. Build alignment, resolve technical disagreements, and keep complex initiatives moving.

Improve engineering practices through mentorship, reusable patterns, and clear technical guidance.

Use AI throughout your engineering work, with sound judgment about where it helps, where it falls short, and how its output should be reviewed. Help the team improve by testing new workflows, sharing what works, and identifying useful opportunities for automation.

Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the systems the team builds.

jobs.description:
About the Project

Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products — voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances.

As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment — making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace.

What You'll Do

- Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation.

- Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally.

- Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed.

- Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise.

- Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes.

- Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience.

Required

- Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing.

- Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction).

- Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction.

- Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels).

- Comfortable improvising and adjusting scripted material on the spot.

- Excellent interpersonal skills; able to build rapport quickly with performers of varying experience levels.

Preferred (nice to have, not required)

- Background in improv, theater direction, or acting coaching.

- Experience directing non-professional or first-time voice talent specifically.

- Familiarity with DAWs or recording software (e.g., Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Reaper) for spot-checking audio quality.

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. jobs.description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a  Head of Infrastructure  to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining  carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads , while building the operational maturity required to support  2x growth .

You will report directly to  Sergei, our CTO,  and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

Telecom infrastructure  — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.

On-premise infrastructure  — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.

Cloud infrastructure  — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.

Stateful systems  — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.

Distributed systems  — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.

AI infrastructure  — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.

Storage system  — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Clerk (Entry Level Opportunity)
jobs.description:
The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical

We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance!

Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team.

Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.  In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.

A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk

Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts

Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals

Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner

Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format

Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given

Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations

Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner

Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance

What you will bring to the role

Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject

Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.

Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines

Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers

A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career

Experience using an exterprise level accounting system

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geo

Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.  Role summary  Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.  The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.  You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.  What you will own  Core security leadership (about half)

Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.  Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.  Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.  Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.  Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.  Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.  Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the comp

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

Ubuntu is already the world’s most widely used Linux in general; we want to make it the world’s best choice for mission-critical systems in these sectors too.

To achieve this, we are investing in processes and engineering, tools and analysis, practices and people. Success in this effort will secure open-source software’s place at the highest tables in industry, where the complex demands of regulation, compliance and certification are demonstrably met.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Post Booking
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.

Your Mission

As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey.

You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace.

You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders.

Your Responsibilities

Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap:  Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution.

Improve the post-booking passenger experience:  Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities.

Optimize CRT contact rate:  Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant.

Use insights to guide decisions:  Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs.

Build alignment across teams:  Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Netherlands.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR

Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.

Als stagiair Business Control draai je actief mee binnen het financiële team van Berenschot. Je ondersteunt de business controllers bij het analyseren van prestaties, het voorbereiden van rapportages en het signaleren van ontwikkelingen die van belang zijn voor de organisatie.

jobs.title: [AI Frontier Div.] AI Inference Platform & Operations Lead (10년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 AI 기술을 실제 제품과 서비스로 연결하고, 새로운 사업 기회를 검증하고 확장하는 조직입니다. 여러 Squad가 서로 다른 고객과 시장을 대상으로 사업을 추진하며, 각 Squad는 제품 개발부터 서비스 운영과 사업 성과까지 책임집니다. 고객의 요구와 실제 사용 결과를 바탕으로 제품을 개선하고, 사업성이 확인된 서비스를 확장해 나갑니다.
  • AI Inference Platform & Operations 팀은 이러한 제품들이 공통으로 사용하는 추론 기반을 만들고, 이를 바탕으로 외부 고객에게 제공하는 추론 서비스를 구축·운영합니다. 자체 모델과 오픈웨이트 모델을 빠르고 안정적으로 서비스에 연결하고, 트래픽이 성장해도 일관된 응답 속도와 가용성을 유지하며, GPU 자원과 추론 비용을 효율적으로 운영하는 것이 팀의 미션입니다.
  • AI Frontier 본부 구성원들은 직급과 연차에 상관없이 의견을 내고, 결정하면 빠르게 실행합니다. 장애를 겪으면 숨기지 않고 포스트모템으로 시스템을 더 단단하게 만들고, 아키텍처와 실험 결과와 의사결정 과정을 문서로 남깁니다. AI 도구를 일상적인 개발·운영 도구로 쓰며, 새로운 모델과 서빙 기술이 나오면 바로 써보고 프로덕션에 적용할 방법을 찾는 문화를 지향합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • Inference fleet과 control plane 소유
    • 추론 플랫폼의 기술 방향과 주요 기술 의사결정을 책임지는 Lead로서 자체 모델과 오픈웨이트 모델(음성·멀티모달 포함)을 위한 서빙 플랫폼을 설계하고, 구축·운영 체계를 수립하며 팀의 실행을 이끕니다.
    • 서빙 엔진과 오케스트레이션 계층을 선택하고, 요청 라우팅, 용량·모델·캐시 배치, 오토스케일링, 멀티 모델·멀티 테넌트 운영 정책을 포함한 기술 로드맵과 운영 표준을 수립합니다.
  • 조직 구축과 협업 구조 정립
    • 팀을 직접 채용·육성하고, AI Research의 컴퓨팅 최적화 R&D 조직, 사내 추론 서비스를 운영하는 IT 조직, 각 사업 Squad 사이의 단일 접점 역할을 합니다.
    • 프로덕션의 워크로드 프로파일과 병목을 R&D 요구사항으로 구체화하고, 연구 결과를 검증·인수·배포하는 루프를 만듭니다.
  • 안전한 모델 온보딩과 플랫폼 경험 제공
    • 새 모델의 성능·품질 회귀 테스트, 릴리즈 자동화, 카나리·롤백, API gateway의 인증·쿼터·rate limit, 토큰 단위 관측성을 구축합니다.
    • 사업 Squad와 모델 개발자가 모델을 빠르고 일관되게 온보딩할 수 있는 셀프서비스 도구와 가이드를 제공합니다.
  • SLO와 운영 신뢰성 확립
    • TTFT·TPOT·end-to-end latency의 p95·p99, 가용성, 에러율, 처리량 등 워크로드별 SLO와 error budget을 각 Squad와 함께 정합니다.
    • 온콜, 장애 대응, 포스트모템, capacity event 대응, deploy safety를 포함한 운영

Mid-Market Account Executive

As an Account Executive on our Mid-Market Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across mid-to-large size organizations. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. Mid-Market reps have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

  • Convert inbound leads to closed opportunities
  • Leverage tools such as Sales Navigator and DiscoverOrg
  • Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end users (SRE, DevOps, DevSecOps)
  • Multi-thread into different departments of a complex organization
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including negotiations and on-site technical demonstrations

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in hunting and closing net new logos
  • Able to strategically map out and break into large scale organizations
  • Curious, motivated, and driven as a sales person
  • Bold on the phones and creative in your emails
  • Able to sit up to 6 hours, traveling to and from client sites via auto, train, or air, up to 30% of the time

Benefits and Growth:

  • Opportunity for Presidents Club

  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.

jobs.location: US - Culver City, California, United States
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Sr. Director Business Development to join our Global Publishing team!

The Business Development team is responsible for business negotiations, partner management, and new expansion opportunities with our largest IP partners, new distribution platforms (e.g. storefronts, hardware manufacturers, subscription services, etc.), and digital payment partners (e.g. Stripe, Visa, Checkout.com, etc.) around the world. Through these relationships, the team is responsible for creating and executing a strategy for each partner that drives audience and revenue growth for Scopely’s portfolio of games.

What You Will Do

Reporting to the SVP Publishing, the Senior Director, Business Development will be responsible for working closely with internal game development teams and key external partners to drive Scopely’s distribution and growth strategy globally.

  • Develop key relationships with top IP partners, new distribution platforms, and digital payment vendors in the gaming industry to support and grow the Scopely global business.
  • Articulate the Scopely vision and how we can most effectively partner together
  • Create and execute on a global business development strategy that connects to our overall distribution strategy and principles.
  • Source and negotiate large complex partnerships that grow Scopely’s overall consumer and commercial presence globally.
  • Partner closely with internal teams to ensure the needs of the business are being met in a timely manner
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally and an appreciation for the way business is conducted in different parts of the world
  • Keep tabs on industry trends by obsessively analyzing the market, playing all the new releases, and attending industry events and conferences

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of Business Development / Partnership experience within the digital entertainment industry
  • Experience creating and executing a global business development strategy
  • Ability to identify and negotiate large scale commercial agreements
  • Gaming experience preferred, and particularly free-to-play games
  • Passion & love for video games
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and all levels of management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changes
  • Ability to analyze data to make data-driven decisions - skills in Excel and Google Sheets necessary
  • Strong presentation and communication skills - Keynote, Powerpoint, or Google Slides skills required
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent required

About the company  Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.  Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering.  We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

The project

Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship.
