jobs.title: AI Safety Residency - SLPreP
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs Preparedness and Policy (SLPreP), we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhDs, postdoctoral researchers, and professors with domain expertise in STEM fields such as Computer Science, Machine Learning, Physics, Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Humanities, or other related disciplines.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion in applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows.
  • Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channel

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Web Design Manager at Anthropic, you will lead the enterprise web design team responsible for how businesses experience Anthropic on the web. Our website is often the first place enterprise buyers encounter Claude, and the pages your team ships need to make complex, technical products feel clear, distinctive, and trustworthy. You'll bring a strong art director's eye to every project, set the craft standard, shape design direction for the next stage of our enterprise web presence, and build a team that does the best work of their careers.

In this role, you'll own the enterprise web design practice: setting priorities, guiding projects from brief to launch, and holding a high bar for visual quality, storytelling, and performance. We're looking for someone who cares deeply about craft and knows how to use art direction (imagery, typography, motion, and composition) to tell a clear, memorable story on every page. You'll partner closely with enterprise marketing as your main day-to-day collaborators on priorities, messaging, and launches, and work alongside web engineering, web strategy and growth, brand and creative, sales and customer teams, product, and external agency partners to ship work that is both beautiful and effective.

  • Lead and manage the enterprise web design team, including hiring, coaching, feedback, and career growth

About NetEase Games:

As a leading internet technology company based in China, NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES and HKEX:9999, “NetEase”) provides premium online services centered around content creation. With extensive offerings across its expanding gaming ecosystem, the Company develops and operates some of China’s most popular and longest-running mobile and PC games. Powered by industry-leading in-house R&D capabilities in China and globally, NetEase creates superior gaming experiences, inspires players, and passionately delivers value for its thriving community worldwide. By infusing play with culture and education with technology, NetEase transforms gaming into a meaningful vehicle to build a more entertaining and enlightened world.

NetEase’s ESG initiatives are among the best in the global media and entertainment industry, earning it a distinction as one of the S&P Global Industry Movers and an “A” rating from MSCI. For more information, please visit: http://ir.netease.com/

Job Description

  1. Proficient in 3D action design and production across multiple styles, with engine-related work experience;
  2. Participate in specific action design tasks and review action assets submitted by outsourcing partners;
  3. Responsible for designing in-game character actions, with in-depth analysis, understanding, and production experience regarding character motion principles;
  4. Collaborate closely with the Lead Artist to define game action style, and produce action design templates and specifications;
  5. Possess strong communication skills and a cooperative attitude, coordinate throughout the entire production pipeline, and deliver the product's art quality.

Job Requirements

  1. Solid foundation in animation design; understanding of cinematography and camera techniques for animation; strong grasp of body mechanics, movement rhythm for both humanoid and non-humanoid characters;
  2. Rich imagination with excellent action design capabilities, able to create smooth and dynamic action performances;
  3. Strong teamwork awareness and good communication/collaboration skills;
  4. Familiarity with action games, with deep understanding of impact feel (game feel) in combat actions;
  5. 8+ years of professional experience in action design for large-scale games.

jobs.title: Senior/Lead Gameplay Animator - 3C & FPS
jobs.location: Canada-Remote; France-Remote; Guangzhou Office; Hangzhou Office; Shanghai Office; Spain-Remote; United Kingdom ; United States-Remote
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior or Lead Gameplay Animator with strong AAA FPS experience to help shape responsive, compelling character movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.
With a focus on Character, Controls, and Camera (3C), you will combine animation craft with practical implementation skills to develop features from early prototypes through final in-game polish. Working closely with gameplay designers, programmers, and technical animators, you will help ensure that character animation, player input, and camera behavior work together to deliver a cohesive player experience.
This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership of gameplay animation features and opportunities to influence the systems and workflows behind them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own gameplay animation features from concept to completion, including reference gathering, prototyping, asset creation, engine integration, debugging, and polish.
  • Create high-quality character movement and action animations, covering locomotion, directional changes, stance transitions, traversal, and combat interactions.
  • Contribute to first-person animation and its relationship with full-body movement, weapon handling, and camera feedback.
  • Partner with designers and programmers to refine movement responsiveness, action timing, transitions, and interruption behavior while preserving believable weight and physicality.
  • Build and refine animation graphs, state machines, blend setups, and animation layers within the project’s engine and tools.
  • Use keyframe animation and motion-capture workflows to deliver animation that meets gameplay and visual requirements.
  • Evaluate your work in playable builds, identify the causes of animation issues, and collaborate across disciplines to resolve them.
  • Work with technical animation and engineering teams to improve workflows and address runtime, asset, and production constraints.
  • For Lead-level appointments, guide feature planning, establish animation quality benchmarks, provide actionable feedback, and mentor teammates while continuing to create and implement animation directly.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience creating and implementing gameplay animation for AAA first-person shooters, with clear ownership of features or animation systems.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating body mechanics, weight, timing, posing, and a clear understanding of responsive gameplay animation.
  • Practical experience taking animation assets into a game engine and iterating on their behavior in playable builds.
  • Working knowledge of animation graphs, state machines, blending, additive animation, and gameplay-driven transitions.
  • An understanding of how character movement, player controls, and camera behavior influence each other and shape game feel.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Game Community Operations Executive to expand and manage our overseas gaming community channels. You will identify and partner with community owners and core player organisers across major platforms, design collaboration models that drive user growth, GMV and ROI, and build a scalable community resource base.
Key Responsibilities
- Expand and operate overseas game communities and community channels; continuously source new partnership resources to drive user growth, GMV and ROI.
- Identify and build relationships with community owners, admins, and core player organisers across Discord, Reddit, Facebook Groups, Telegram, and game forums.
- Design and execute partnership models — including CPS deals, exclusive offers, community events, and bot integrations — to secure long-term, stable output from partners.
- Plan community growth campaigns around new game launches, version updates, and trending game topics; track traffic, payment, and conversion performance.
- Build and maintain a community resource library and partnership SOPs; explore AI and bot tools to improve outreach and operational efficiency.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree or above.
- Strong cold outreach, business communication, and relationship management skills, with a proven ability to build partnerships from scratch.
- Good understanding of overseas gaming community ecosystems (e.g., Discord, Reddit, Telegram, Facebook Groups, game forums).
- Able to use English as a working language.
Good to Have
- Experience in overseas community operations, partnerships, affiliate marketing, KOL/KOC engagement, or game operations.
- Existing community or partnership resources in European or North American markets.
- Avid gamer with strong familiarity with overseas player culture.

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Game Category Operations Executive to own and grow an assigned game category on our overseas game trading platform. You will drive end-to-end category operations — from trend monitoring and merchandising to campaigns and promotions — and collaborate cross-functionally to grow category transaction volume (GMV).
Key Responsibilities
- Own overall operations for an assigned game category: develop and execute operation plans covering game trend/hotspot monitoring, merchandising, campaign and promotion follow-through; coordinate with upstream and downstream partners to grow category transaction volume.
- Take ownership of category transaction performance; identify growth opportunities through conversion funnel analysis and market insights.
- Research games and their trading markets; propose operational strategies and product improvement directions.
- Continuously monitor and analyse operational data of live game categories to identify issues and improve the user experience.
- Develop a deep understanding of players' day-to-day gaming scenarios, resolve real user pain points, and uncover opportunities for trading or top-up/recharge services within these scenarios.
Requirements
- At least 1 year of experience in overseas game operations, with in-depth knowledge of at least one game genre (SLG, card games, or RPG) or pan-entertainment products, and a good grasp of industry trends.
- Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret operational metrics and translate them into actionable insights and optimisation plans.
- Solid understanding of gamer communities — able to quickly identify where player groups gather, source relevant information, and apply it to drive business growth.
- Innovative and self-driven, with strong learning ability, communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.
Good to Have
- Proficiency in additional foreign languages.
- Overseas study or work experience.

Scale Labs, Research Scientist — AI Safety and Alignment

As the leading data and evaluation partner for frontier AI companies, Scale plays a central role in understanding and safeguarding AI systems. Building on this expertise, Scale Labs has launched a new team focused on technical AI safety and policy research, to bridge the gap between frontier AI research and policy, helping policymakers make informed, evidence-based decisions about AI capabilities and risks.

Our research tackles some of the hardest open problems in AI safety: assessing the alignment of frontier models, developing control protocols and monitoring methods, preserving the monitorability, understanding failure modes in multi-agent systems and recursive self-improvement. We collaborate closely with partners across industry, the public sector, and academia and regularly publish our findings. We are looking for talented researchers to join us in shaping this vision.

As a Research Scientist on this team, you will conduct research and build evaluations, tools, and datasets that help us understand and reduce risks from frontier AI systems. For example, you might do any or all of the following:

  • Design and stress-test control protocols and monitoring systems that detect and limit unsafe behavior by AI models and agents in deployment;
  • Build alignment evaluations that probe for deception, sabotage, scheming, reward hacking, and other misaligned behaviors;
  • Study monitorability, including whether a model’s reasoning stays faithful and legible enough to supervise, and how training methods and deployment practices can preserve or erode it;
  • Investigate risks that emerge when multiple AI agents interact, such as collusion, coordination failures and steerability;
  • Develop threat models and evaluations for AI systems that automate AI research and development, to track progress toward recursive self-improvement and inform preparedness planning;
  • Work with government agencies and other labs to scope and design evaluations that measure and mitigate risks from advanced AI;
  • Publish research and evaluation methodologies, and write technical reports for policymakers.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Commitment to our mission of promoting safe, secure, and trustworthy AI as capabilities continue to advance.
  • Practical experience conducting technical research collaboratively. You should be comfortable building and instrumenting ML pipelines, building evaluation harnesses, running experiments on frontier models and agents, and quickly turning new ideas from the research literature into working prototypes.
  • Familiarity with current research in at least one of the areas above.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function, using automation, quantitative risk and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The risks we assess span Anthropic's full security landscape, so the team needs breadth across domains and the judgment to go deep wherever a decision demands it. Security Risk, in deep partnership with Security Engineering, helps define the security program and shapes how investment and treatment decisions get made.

The conventional GRC playbook was not built for a company shipping frontier AI. You will help define what replaces it, with a direct line to CISO-level decisions. As a Security Risk Analyst you will take risk questions from leadership and partner teams and drive them to a decision. Sometimes that is a fast, structured qualitative assessment and other times it is a deep FAIR-based quantitative analysis. Either way you bring leadership a clear position, the tradeoffs, and honest uncertainty, and you defend it under challenge. In parallel, you will help turn quantitative risk into a product partner teams can leverage, and define the standards a growing risk function will run on.

Key responsibilities

  • Enable leadership and partner teams to make risk-informed decisions. Take ambiguous risk questions, drive them to a documented decision, and communicate the quantitative and qualitative tradeoffs clearly

  • Lead quantitative analysis of the company's top security risk scenarios using FAIR, calibrated estimation, and simulation, working with the engineers who own the systems and presenting results in terms leadership can act on

  • Partner with Security Engineering to assess threat scenarios and control effectiveness so security investment is right-sized to actual risk and remediation is sequenced where it buys down the most risk

  • Frame escalations and risk treatment decisions with a clear recommendation, an honest statement of uncertainty, and re-evaluation triggers, and pressure test those decisions with risk owners

  • Shape the analysis and narrative behind leadership risk reviews, and help define risk appetite and the risk metrics the organization should measure and why

  • Use AI and automation to scale risk analysis, and own the calibration and quality review that keep the outputs

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. jobs.title: [Operations Div.] Strategic Planning Dept. Member (3년 이상)

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • 사업계획 및 성과관리: 사업부/자회사 대상 연간 사업계획 수립, 목표 설정(OKR/KPI), 분기별 경영 리뷰 및 성과 모니터링 총괄
  • 전사 운영체계 및 거버넌스 설계/개선: 조직 간 역할·책임(R&R) 정립, 자원배분 최적화, 업무 프로세스 및 제도 설계·운영·모니터링
  • 전사 전략 프로젝트 수행: 경영진 수명 전사 전략과제 기획 및 실행, 크로스펑셔널 협업 조율

  • 전사 또는 그룹 차원의 사업계획 및 성과관리 사이클을 운영해본 경험이 있는 분
  • 전사 운영 프로세스 및 제도 설계, 조직 간 R&R 정립 경험이 있는 분
  • Business Fluent 이상의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량
  • 게임·미디어·엔터테인먼트 산업에 대한 직·간접 경험 및 이해도

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 전화 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > 1차/2차 실무 면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 최종 면접 (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사

jobs.title: [AI Frontier Div.] Head of AI Product Dev Chapter Dept. (10년 이상)
jobs.description:

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.

  • AI Product Dev Chapter는 소속 엔지니어들의 기술 역량과 성장을 책임지는 조직입니다. 각 스쿼드의 PO가 제품과 사업을 이끌고, 챕터는 기술 방향·개발 품질·공통 기반·인재 육성을 맡습니다. 스쿼드가 개발·운영하는 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. 챕터의 목표는 스쿼드의 AI 기술이 고객 가치와 매출로 이어지는 속도를 높이는 것입니다.
  • 스쿼드가 만드는 AI 제품 중 일부는 실제 고객에게 출시해 운영하는 단계에 들어서고 있습니다. 고객 요구에 맞는 기능을 적시에 출시하려면 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 정하고, 제품 품질과 운영 비용을 고려해 기술적 병목을 해결해야 합니다. 챕터는 PO와 함께 이 과정을 이끌고, 여러 스쿼드에서 얻은 경험을 본부 공통의 개발 역량으로 발전시켜 갑니다.
  • 이번에 합류하실 분은 챕터장으로서 제품별 기술 의사결정과 공통 개발·검증 체계를 이끌고, 엔지니어를 채용·육성하며 챕터의 일하는 방식을 만들어 갑니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 제품 기술 의사결정: PO와 함께 고객 요구를 기술 과제로 구체화하고, 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 조율합니다. 스쿼드별 기술 스택이 파편화되지 않도록 각 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. PoC가 프로덕션 전환까지 이어지도록 중요한 기술 병목은 직접 설계 검토와 프로토타이핑에 참여해 해결합니다.
  • AI 기술 PoC와 품질 검증: 새로운 모델·API를 빠르게 비교 평가할 수 있는 PoC 환경을 만들고, AI 기능을 실제 사용 시나리오와 데이터로 평가합니다. 실패 사례와 변경 전후의 품질·응답 속도·비용을 비교해 제품 개선으로 연결합니다. 평가는 고객이 비용을 내고 쓸 품질인지까지 확인하고, 결과는 PO가 사업 판단에 쓸 수 있게 정리합니다.
  • AI 기반 개발 생산성: AI 코딩 도구가 코드베이스와 제품의 맥락, 개발 규칙을 이해하고 테스트 작성·배포 설정 같은 반복 작업을 맡을 수 있도록 개발 환경을 갖춥니다. AI가 만든 코드와 설계를 사람이 판단할 리뷰 기준을 세우고, 테스트 자동화로 빠르게 검증할 수 있게 합니다. 새로운 AI 개발 도구는 생산성·품질·보안 기준으로 평가해 도입하고, 구성원이 찾은 좋은 방법은 가이드와 세미나로 스쿼드 전체에 퍼뜨립니다.
  • 공통 개발·운영 기반: 반복 개발 비용을 줄이고 새 기능을 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 개발 템플릿, CI/CD, 클라우드, 모니터링 등 공통 기반을 만듭니다. 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 적용 범위와 유지보수 담당을 정하고, 쌓이는 기술 부채를 찾아 해결합니다. 제품 출시와 운영을 위해 인프라·보안 등 다양한 부서와 협업해 안정성과 비용 효율을 높입니다.
  • 엔지니어 채용·성장·평가: 사업 계획에 필요한 엔지니어 역량을 정리하고, 이를 검증할 JD·기술 과제·면접 기준을 만들어 채용과 온보딩을 주도합니다. 정기 1on1·멘토링과 테크 토크·코드 리뷰로 구성원의 성장을 돕고 스쿼드 간 기술을 공유합니다. PO와 협력해 실제 기여에 근거한 성과 평가와 경력 개발을 이끕니다.

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤이 보유한 AI 기술과 선행 R&D 자산을 기반으로 새로운 제품과 사업을 만드는 조직입니다. AI Model과 Agent의 가능성을 실제 고객의 문제와 연결하며, 게임과 비게임 영역에서 끊임없이 0→1을 시도합니다.
  • 우리는 아직 가능성이 분명하지 않은 영역에서도 작은 기회를 발견하고, 고객과 파트너, 기술과 자원을 연결해 지속 가능한 사업으로 성장할 조건을 만들어갑니다.
  • AI Business Development는 이 과정에서 사업의 동력을 만드는 역할입니다. 제품이 완성되기 전부터 고객과 대화하며 수요를 검증하고, 파트너십과 사업모델을 설계해 실제 계약과 매출로 연결합니다. Product Owner와 함께 사업 전체를 바라보며, 새로운 사업이 실행되고 성장하는 데 필요한 기회를 만들어갈 분을 찾습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 신규 사업 기회 발굴 및 GTM 실행
    • AI 기술·R&D 자산과 고객의 문제를 연결해 사업 가설을 수립하고, 초기 시장 진입부터 사업화까지 추진합니다.
  • 초기 고객 개발 및 수요 검증
    • 제품 기획 단계부터 잠재 고객에게 직접 접근해 실제 과제와 도입 조건을 파악하고, 공동 개발·PoC·구매 등 구체적인 참여를 이끌어냅니다.
  • 전략적 파트너십 및 사업 기반 확보
    • 사업에 필요한 고객 접점, 기술, 데이터, 유통 역량을 가진 파트너를 발굴하고, 상호 이해관계를 반영한 협력 구조를 설계·실행합니다.
  • 사업모델 설계 및 매출 계약 리드
    • 고객 가치와 제공 비용을 바탕으로 사업모델과 가격 정책을 설계하고, 제안·협상·계약부터 후속 사업 확장까지 주도합니다.
  • PO와 함께 사업화 실행
    • 고객 요구와 사업 조건을 제품 범위·우선순위·일정에 연결하고, PO 및 개발·연구 조직과 함께 출시·고객 도입·운영을 추진합니다.
  • 사업 추진의 장애물 해결
    • 기술·데이터·보안·법무 등 주요 제약에 대한 대안을 마련하고, 내외부 이해관계자의 의사결정과 필요한 자원을 확보해 사업을 전진시킵니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 사업 전략 또는 사업개발을 주도해 실질적인 성과를 내고, 조직 성장을 리딩한 경험이 있으신 분

  • 불확실한 환경에서 스스로 사업 기회를 발굴하고, 제품이 완성

jobs.title: Head of Compliance
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.  We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.  You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

Strong judgment

Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™

Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

Our work spans building custom AI applications that reach millions of users, generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs, and providing upskilling and AI advisory services. We're building our UK business from a standing start, and we need someone with a lot of energy to help it move.

As a Strategist, you'll help grow Scale's UK business, partnering with technical stakeholders to identify and win opportunities across public sector (central government and defence & security) and enterprise. You'll sit at the centre of our go-to-market effort, combining business development groundwork with the bids and tender work that turns an opportunity into a contract. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations. The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer. The FDPM owns product outcomes inside a portfolio of enterprise accounts: earning deep trust with senior customer stakeholders, driving deployments to production, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to the platform team. The best FDPMs have shipped products into large organizations and can tell the difference between a customer's stated request, their actual problem, and what the platform should do.

What You'll Do

  • Own product outcomes for our highest impact enterprise accounts. You are the accountable PM for product delivery and customer value.

  • Partner closely with FDEs so the account runs as a coordinated team, not a set of parallel workstreams.
  • Identify and develop expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value
  • Represent customer reality to platform and leadership with enough credibility that it changes decisions.

jobs.description:

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.

Scale's Machine Learning Research team builds the foundation for the next generation of AI systems — pushing the boundaries of what's possible with frontier models while ensuring safety, reliability, and alignment at every step. Our work spans generative AI, reinforcement learning and advanced post-training methods, scalable oversight, synthetic data pipelines, red teaming, and evaluation science.

We are developing a large-scale hybrid human-machine system to power machine learning pipelines for dozens of industry-leading customers. These models and systems form the backbone of Scale's long-term strategy, enabling billions of tasks monthly and supporting some of the most complex and advanced use cases in the AI ecosystem.

As an intern, you'll work on a combination of deeply technical ML applications in production and cutting-edge research problems, with mentorship from world-class researchers and the opportunity to collaborate with leading teams across industry and academia. Interns own real, published or shipped work — not side projects.

Example Projects

  • Measure the dangerous capabilities of frontier models and conduct preparedness research
  • Research the science and creation of new benchmarks for frontier models
  • Develop new methods for training models to excel on extremely difficult reasoning problems that require long chains of thought
  • Research reinforcement learning and post-training methods that improve model reliability on high-stakes tasks
  • Research scalable oversight protocols that enable humans to produce and quality control reasoning chains beyond their native capabilities
  • Study the boundaries of model generalization and capabilities to inform data-driven advancements
  • Research synthetic and hybrid data with humans in the loop to scale up high-quality data generation
  • Take models currently in production, identify areas for improvement, improve them using retraining and hyperparameter searches, then deploy without regressing on core model characteristics
  • Create post-training or agentic solutions that integrate into our ability to deliver applications for enterprise and public sector clients

Required to Have

  • Currently enrolled in a BS, MS or PhD program with a focus on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Natural Language Processing, with a graduation date in Fall 2

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Scientist, Evaluations
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale works with the industry's leading AI labs to provide high quality data and accelerate progress in GenAI research. We are looking for Research Scientists and Research Engineers with expertise in LLM post-training (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) and evaluation. This role is on the evaluation pod within the GenAI Research Organization and will focus on building benchmarks and diagnosing model failure modes in both text and multimodal modalities.

In this role, you will develop rigorous evaluations and diagnostic methods that reveal where frontier models fail and why. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to define best practices in evaluation-driven AI development. You will also partner with top foundation model labs to translate failure analysis into technical and strategic input on the next generation of generative AI models.

You will:

  • Analyze model behavior to identify, characterize, and diagnose failure modes in frontier LLMs and Agents. You’ll identify everything from capability gaps and reasoning errors to robustness and alignment issues, all focusing on RCA.
  • Design and build benchmarks and evaluation methods that measure LLM capabilities in both text and multimodal modalities.
  • Apply post-training expertise (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) to connect observed failures to the data and training interventions that address them.
  • Publish research findings in top-tier AI conferences.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of deep learning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale model fine-tuning.
  • Experience with post-training techniques such as RLHF, preference modeling, or instruction tuning, and with LLM evaluation or benchmark development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Published research in areas of machine learning at major conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, etc.) and/or journals.
  • Previous experience in a customer facing role.

Scale is building the agentic operating system that powers AI deployment across the world's most important organizations. The Platform PM is the person who determines what that foundation needs to be — and holds the bar on how well it gets built.

This is not a roadmap PM, a program manager, or a feature tracker. The Platform PM owns the core infrastructure that every FD team builds on top of: defining the foundation before anything else can be built reliably, sequencing work against real customer commitments and FD team velocity, identifying which FD-built patterns are ready to graduate to core, and ensuring that every capability that ships does so at a bar customers can trust without thinking about it.

The best Platform PMs have defined platform capabilities at production bar in high-stakes environments and understand the difference between what is necessary to build, what is interesting to build, and what should never be built at all.

What You'll Do

  • Define the foundation. Determine what needs to be true at the core platform layer — across each capability pillar — before anything reliable can be built on top of it.
  • Sequence it. Prioritize and order platform work given customer commitments, FD team velocity needs, and what is actually blocking progress today. Getting this wrong means building on an unstable base or building the right things in the wrong order and paying for it in rework and FD team drag.
  • Identify patterns and graduate capabilities. Watch what FD teams are building across the application layer, determine what is genuinely repeating, and make the call on what moves to core — and when. Do not rush graduation or delay it out of caution.
  • Hold the quality bar. Every capability on the platform roadmap earns its place twice: once by being necessary, and again by being done well enough that customers trust it without thinking about it. Keep the platform from becoming a graveyard of half-built capabilities.
  • Unlock delivery team time to value. Forward deployed delivery teams should spend their time solving the hardest customer problems, not rebuilding plumbing on every engagement. That requires a platform that is secure by default, deployable anywhere, observable in production, and equipped with the agentic primitives, eval infrastructure, expert judgment capture, and data reasoning capabilities that every agent workload needs.
  • Partner across the organization. Work closely with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and BU leads to surface signal, resolve sequencing tradeoffs, and keep the roadmap grounded in what is actually blocking work.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6+ years in product management with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products at production bar.

jobs.description:
About Scale

Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.

The Role

The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI. The government's AI Opportunities Action Plan set out to "mainline AI into the veins" of the country, and the focus has now moved to delivery: the Incubator for AI (i.AI) is shipping tools like the Humphrey suite into departments, a Sovereign AI Unit and AI Growth Zones are being stood up, and civilian departments are under real pressure to move from pilots to production. Scale can play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications that shift depends on.

We're looking for someone to lead that work in central government. This isn’t about staying in the office and managing a team of sales people, its about building the business from the front. You'd own our commercial relationships across civilian departments, starting where the near-term pipeline is strongest: HMRC, DWP, and NHS.

This is a critical role reporting directly to our Head of Public Sector, UK. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into these departments before and knows how they actually make decisions, not just how the org charts look.

What you'll do

  • Own our commercial plan and pipeline for UK civilian central government
  • Find, shape, and close deals yourself, from the first conversation through to contract and into delivery
  • Use the relationships you already have across departments like HMRC, DWP, and NHS
  • Work the frameworks, tenders and teaming, and know which route to market is worth the effort and which isn't.
  • Be a credible counterpart to senior civil servants, and turn what they need into work we can deliver
  • Stay close to our product and delivery teams so what we sell is what we build
  • Hire and lead a small team over time, and help shape the wider UK public sector plan with the UK Public Sector Lead

What we're looking for

  • You've sold and delivered technology or transformation work to UK civilian central government, either from a vendor or from inside government
  • You’ve rolled up your sleeves and built something from scratch, whether that’s a new vertical, territory or product launch
  • You know at least one major department well (e.g. HMRC, DWP, or NHS) and how it buys
  • You understand public sector procurement: frameworks, tenders, and buying that runs through a lot of stakeholders

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings together top researchers and domain experts to collaborate on high-impact work that are shaping the future of AI. jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.

The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

  • Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.
  • Build and lead the team. Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.
  • Drive design execution across the Enterprise product. Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.

Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

Who you are

  • 5+ years managing product design teams
  • Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into eleg

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Orchestration Platform

jobs.description:
Scale is building reliable AI systems for the world’s most important decisions. Our products help leading enterprises, governments, and frontier AI labs build, deploy, and evaluate AI systems at scale.

The Orchestration Platform is a core technology used across the company to run durable, reliable, and scalable workflows. It powers the complex, long-running processes behind Scale’s products - from data and model-evaluation pipelines to operational systems and customer-facing workflows.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve this foundational orchestration platform. You will design the primitives, services, and developer experience that enable teams across Scale to author, operate, observe, and safely scale distributed workflows. You will:

  • Build durable workflow infrastructure using technologies such as Temporal, Cadence, Kubernetes, and cloud-native systems.

  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and application teams to understand workflow needs and turn them into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience of services that run critical company workflows.
  • Establish technical standards and best practices for distributed workflow development, deployment, testing, and incident response.
  • Drive cross-functional technical decisions and communicate platform direction clearly to engineers and stakeholders.

  • 5+ years of full-time software engineering experience, with a focus on backend, infrastructure, and distributed systems.
  • Experience building and operating production systems with strong requirements for reliability, availability, and scale.
  • Deep familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal, Cadence, AWS Step Functions, Kubernetes, or similar systems.
  • Deep familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized production environments, and familiarity with Terraform, Docker.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed-systems concepts, including asynchronous execution, retries, idempotency, fault tolerance, state management, and observability.
  • A track record of leading technically complex projects from design through rollout and ongoing operation.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with platform consumers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nices to haves:

  • Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Firebolt) and data pipeline/ETL

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human eval and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition.

At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI.

At the foundation of these products is the Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will support the design and development of shared platforms used across Scale. This includes designing our foundational data platforms and lifecycle, architecting Scale’s core cloud infrastructure and orchestration stack, and redefining how engineers develop, build, test, and deploy software at Scale. You’ll also get widespread exposure to the forefront of the AI race as Scale sees it in enterprises, startups, governments, and large tech companies.

You will:

  • Drive the design, and implementation of our foundational platforms and systems, working closely with stakeholders and internal customers to understand and refine requirements.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
  • Proactively identifying opportunities for, and driving improvements to, current programming practices, including process enhancements and tool upgrades.
  • Presenting technical information to teams and stakeholders, providing guidance and insight on development processes and technologies.

  • Possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Technical discovery and qualification. jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media and telecommunications to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, help humans, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

Applied AI is moving faster than ever. New foundation models, reasoning techniques, agent architectures, and research papers emerge every week. Yet building AI systems that reliably solve real-world problems remains one of the hardest engineering challenges.

As a Staff Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI), you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, evaluate, and deploy intelligent systems that combine frontier models with structured knowledge, retrieval, traditional machine learning, and enterprise software.

Unlike traditional ML roles that focus on a single model or product, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of AI challenges spanning multiple industries and use cases. jobs.description:
About Scale AI

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact.

Scale Frontier Data is the organization behind the training and evaluation data that frontier labs depend on. We build the systems, tooling, and expert workflows that turn hard human expertise into signals that models can learn from, across reasoning, coding, agentic tool use, and domain expertise.

Reinforcement learning environments are now the center of gravity for that work: the difference between a model that demos well and a model that reliably completes long-horizon work is almost always the quality of the environments and reward signals it was trained against.

Responsibilities

As a Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments, you'll own the technical foundation for how Scale builds, runs, verifies, and delivers RL environments at scale.

An RL environment is a real piece of software: a containerized world with real dependencies, real state, real tools, and a grader that has to be correct even when the agent is creative about breaking it. Building one is a full-stack engineering problem. Building thousands of them reproducibly, cheaply, with trustworthy reward signals and throughput measured in millions of rollouts is a systems problem that very few people have solved.

You'll work on both. You'll design the platform: sandboxed execution, environment packaging and versioning, rollout orchestration, trajectory capture, verifier frameworks, and the authoring surfaces that let engineers and domain experts produce environments without reinventing infrastructure each time. And you'll go deep on the environments themselves by instrumenting real applications, designing task suites that expose specific capability gaps, and building graders that hold up under adversarial optimization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams, and you'll still be the person who writes the hard part.

We are building the Finance team to help make data-driven and financially sound decisions for Scale. The Finance team is responsible for improving strategic, financial, and operational decisions by partnering with the leadership team in making critical decisions across Scale.

The Finance team is responsible for owning the company’s budget, helping to drive quarterly and annual planning processes, allocating and deploying the company’s resources efficiently, and performing financial analyses in partnership with all departments. You will have a unique opportunity to work closely with department heads on real-time high-priority business issues and use quantitative insights to drive better decision-making across Scale. The ideal candidate will not only have the technical skills to support their recommendations but also strong interpersonal skills to manage various stakeholders. We hope you'll join us!

You will:

  • Serve as the Finance business partner to support the Applications BU Leadership Team in quarterly and annual strategic and financial planning discussions
  • Engage with the business to manage revenue, delivery, headcount and expense forecasts, own weekly and monthly financial reporting, KPIs, presentations, and other critical analysis requests
  • Partner with Business Unit Owners to own and improve the Delivery and Revenue forecasting processes
  • Evaluate investment strategies, facilitate ad-hoc analyses, and own special projects requiring complex financial models including, but not limited to:
    • Support the launch of new product lines
    • Assess new risks and opportunities for corporate initiatives (e.g. expanding operations into new locations, compensation philosophy, etc.)
    • Drive internal initiatives to improve data infrastructure and reporting
  • Partner closely with the accounting team during the month-end close process to ensure accurate general ledger and company-wide financial statement reporting
  • Develop and maintain KPIs to assist with the decision-making that aligns with the company’s objectives

Ideally, you would have:

  • 4+ years of financial analysis experience working directly in a Corporate Finance or a Strategic Finance role
  • 2 years of investment banking or top-tier consulting experience
  • Management experience
  • Demonstrated excellent project management skills, ability to manage and manipulate large data sets, critically analyze existing processes, and identify opportunities for process improvement
  • Strong knowledge of Google Suite, and MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); expert Excel modeling skills

Nice to haves:

  • A Bachelor’s degree with a major in finance or accounting
  • Experience in SQL and Business Intelligence tools
  • Experience with Anaplan and/or Adaptive Insights

jobs.description:

As a Strategic Projects Lead (SPL), you will leading initiatives that will drive $XXM+ in new revenue for the business. jobs.title: Strategist, Qatar
jobs.description:
Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:

  1. Building custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens and government employees
  2. Generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs
  3. Upskilling and AI advisory services to spread the impact of AI

As a Strategist, you’ll be responsible for growing the Global Public Sector business unit and partnering with technical stakeholders to identify and win major opportunities in the public sector and selected accounts across Qatar. You will develop and execute on a go to market strategy for customer acquisition, navigating a dynamic and often unstructured environment to make impactful decisions. This is a technical role that requires the following:

  • A deep interest in AI and data and the ability to articulate technical concepts in simple, precise language
  • Experience successfully navigating and partnering with governments and senior stakeholders across Qatar
  • Working cross-functionally with Scale Leadership, Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Compliance to ensure customer success
  • An ability to earn trust and develop close relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within accounts
  • An ability to uncover business challenges, shape and scope how AI can address these challenges, and build business cases to show the impact and value of Scale’s offerings

At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions—we’re enabling the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and be a founding member of our team, we’d love to hear from you.

You will:

  • Work closely with Scale Leadership, Head of EMEA, Engagement Management, Account Executives and the EMEA Strategy team on overall GTM strategy across Qatar
  • Work with potential clients to identify impactful AI solutions and shape and scope their high level vision for AI
  • Demonstrate the value and impact associated with each AI application
  • Navigate complicated organizations, developing relationships, and answering client questions to qualify an identified opportunity to a signed deal
  • Build trust and credibility with clients, acting as a reliable AI advisor beyond the core operating capacity of projects
  • Specific responsibilities include:
    • Customer Communications
    • Relationship Management
    • AI analysis and thought leadership
    • Financial modeling and commercial literacy
    • Pitch deck and proposal development
    • AI workshop design and execution
    • Creating demos of potential AI solutions using tools like Replit or Lovable
    • Measuring and communicating the impact and value of AI

jobs.title: Subcontracts Manager, Public Sector
jobs.description:
Scale AI is at the forefront of the AI revolution, helping the U.S. government unlock the potential of AI across national security missions. We’re building and deploying agentic AI solutions on large, complex government programs that increasingly require Scale technology to integrate with capabilities delivered by traditional defense primes and other subcontractors.

We’re hiring a subcontracts manager to own the day-to-day relationships, execution, and integration of subcontractors supporting our Public Sector programs. You will work alongside Scale’s Delivery team and technical leads to ensure our subcontractors understand where their work fits into the broader technical solution, deliver against committed timelines and requirements, and remain fully integrated into our overall program execution.

This role requires unusual range: you should be equally comfortable reviewing an integrated master schedule and discussing technical dependencies as you are resolving an invoice, onboarding a new subcontractor, or flowing down security requirements. You will need technical fluency to understand what Scale is building and how subcontractor capabilities fit into the solution, while using strong program management and influence to hold external partners accountable for results.

You will:

  • Own day-to-day relationships with subcontractors supporting large Public Sector programs, including major defense primes and specialized technical partners
  • Understand Scale’s overall technical solution and ensure each subcontractor clearly understands how its scope, interfaces, and deliverables fit into that solution
  • Translate prime contract milestones and program requirements into clear subcontractor deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and acceptance criteria
  • Integrate subcontractor activities into the broader Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and proactively identify dependencies, risks, and potential schedule impacts
  • Hold subcontractors accountable for committed scope, timelines, deliverables, status reporting, and corrective actions when execution falls behind
  • Partner closely with Scale technical leads and program managers who will review and approve the technical quality of subcontractor work, while you own execution, coordination, and follow-through
  • Establish clear operating cadences with subcontractors, including status reviews, action tracking, risk management, decision logs, and escalation mechanisms
  • Drive resolution of technical and programmatic blockers across Scale teams, subcontractors, customers, and other external stakeholders
  • Lead onboarding of new subcontractors and ensure they have the program context, systems access, security requirements, documentation, and operating processes necessary to execute
  • Coordinate the flow-down and tracking of applicable security, access, compliance, and program requirements<

jobs.title: Subject Matter Expert
jobs.description:
Subject Matter Expert Role Description

Engagement Type: Part-time (Hourly) — Work as many or as few hours as you'd like, with the flexibility to set your own schedule based on your availability.

Overview

The Subject Matter Expert is a specialized role focused exclusively on quality evaluation and standards definition within assigned projects. This role is designed for subject-matter experts who provide high-value insights through audits, quality frameworks, and performance analysis.

The Subject Matter Expert does not engage in contributor management, real-time support, or operational task coordination. Instead, the role centers on assessing output quality, identifying systemic issues, and recommending improvements to ensure high standards are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Audits & Evaluation

  • Conduct structured audits of task outputs to evaluate accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines.
  • Apply domain expertise to assess nuanced or complex work requiring specialized knowledge.
  • Identify patterns of quality issues and flag systemic gaps impacting output standards.

Quality Standards & Benchmarking

  • Define and refine quality benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and evaluation criteria based on project needs.
  • Contribute to the development of gold standards and reference materials for high-quality outputs.
  • Ensure quality frameworks reflect domain-specific rigor where applicable.

Analysis & Insights

  • Analyze audit results to generate actionable insights on quality trends and performance gaps.
  • Provide structured reports with clear recommendations to improve overall output quality.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to calibrate on quality expectations and scoring consistency.

Process Improvement (Quality-Focused)

  • Recommend improvements to workflows, guidelines, and evaluation processes based on audit findings.
  • Support calibration efforts to ensure alignment across reviewers and quality stakeholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives strictly related to quality outcomes.

Out of Scope (Role Boundaries)

  • No task assignment, queue management, or operational oversight.
  • No people management or performance management responsibilities.

jobs.title: SWE Fellow - Human Frontier Collective (Canada)
jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE: This is a fully remote, 1099 independent contractor opportunity with an estimated duration of six months and the potential for extension. To be eligible, candidates must be authorized to work in Canada; visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) Fellowship brings together top researchers and domain experts to collaborate on high-impact work that are shaping the future of AI. As an HFC Fellow, you’ll apply your academic and professional expertise to help design, evaluate, and interpret advanced generative AI systems—while gaining exposure to cutting-edge research and working alongside an interdisciplinary network of leading thinkers.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborative Work: Get invited to engage in high-impact projects with our partnered AI labs and platforms. Design complex, domain-specific problems and datasets to rigorously evaluate AI models, and provide expert insights that enhance their accuracy, reasoning, and overall performance.
  • Join the HFC Community: Beyond the work, you’ll become part of a supportive, interdisciplinary network of innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI across domains.
  • Contribute to Research Publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who Should Apply

  • Professional and Academic Background: 5+ years of software engineering or related technical experience, or equivalent domain expertise through academic work (e.g. PhD, postdoctoral research, or faculty experience in Computer Science or related field).
  • Skills: Demonstrated coding proficiency and analytical abilities, with deep expertise in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Java, Rust, Swift, JavaScript, or C++.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion in applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

Why Join the HFC?

  • Professional Development: High-impact experts expand their influence through review projects, advisory roles, and research—while deepening their AI expertise, strengthening analytical and problem-solving skills, and engaging with pioneering AI applications in science and technology.

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Integration & Test Lead, Public Sector
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineering, Integration & Test (SEIT) Lead to own the technical execution of software demonstrations for classified government customers. You will turn customer mission needs into demo-ready capability. That means defining requirements and architecture, running integration and test, and delivering demonstrations on tight timelines in secure environments. You will be the technical bridge between program management, software development, and the customer, and the person who makes sure what we show works and is traceable to what the customer needs.

You will:

  • Lead multiple software demo efforts, from concept through customer demonstration and after-action reporting
  • Turn customer mission needs, CONOPS, and use cases into system requirements, demo objectives, and success criteria
  • Partner with the Chief Engineer and Chief Architect to own the system architecture and interface definitions (ICDs), and coordinate across software, data, and third-party/GFE components
  • Build and run integration and test plans, test procedures, and verification matrices (RVTM)
  • Plan and run demo events: environment setup, dry runs, rehearsals, go/no-go reviews, and on-site support
  • Partner with the infrastructure and engineering teams to maintain integration and test environments on classified networks and in SCIFs, working with security and IT on accreditation needs
  • Lead technical reviews (system requirements reviews, test readiness reviews) and present to customer stakeholders at the right level of technical depth
  • Manage technical risk, configuration baselines, and change control across fast-moving development cycles for critical demonstrations

Must Haves:

  • An active TS/SCI clearance
  • 10+ years of systems engineering experience, with 5+ years in integration and test of software-intensive systems
  • 3+ years in a technical lead role on DoD or IC programs
  • Hands-on experience delivering software demos, prototypes, or rapid capability efforts to government customers
  • Strong command of requirements management, verification and validation, and interface control
  • Experience working in classified environments (SCIFs, air-gapped networks, cross-domain constraints)
  • Comfortable presenting to senior government and military stakeholders
  • Knowledge of risk management framework (RMF) / authority to operate (ATO) processes

As the lead of this team, you will define how the company ships software, establishing the patterns for deploying into complex government and high-security environments, rather than just running Terraform scripts. jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale's LLM post-training platform team builds our internal distributed framework for large language model training. The platform powers MLEs, researchers, data scientists, and operators for fast and automatic training and evaluation of LLMs. It also serves as the underlying training framework for the data quality evaluation pipeline.

Scale is uniquely positioned at the heart of the field of AI as an indispensable provider of training and evaluation data and end-to-end solutions for the ML lifecycle. You will work closely with Scale’s ML teams and researchers to build the foundation platform which supports all our ML research and development works. You will be building and optimizing the platform to enable our next generation LLM training, inference and data curation.

If you are excited about shaping the future AI via fundamental innovations, we would love to hear from you!

You will:

  • Build, profile and optimize our training and inference framework.
  • Collaborate with ML and research teams to accelerate their research and development, and enable them to develop the next generation of models and data curation.
  • Research and integrate state-of-the-art technologies to optimize our ML system.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Passionate about system optimization
  • Experience with multi-node LLM training and inference
  • Experience with developing large-scale distributed ML systems
  • Experience with post-training methods like RLHF/RLVR and related algorithms like PPO/GRPO etc.
  • Strong software engineering skills, proficient in frameworks and tools such as CUDA, Pytorch, transformers, flash attention, etc.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to operate in a cross functional team environment.

Nice to haves:

  • Demonstrated expertise in post-training methods and/or next generation use cases for large language models including instruction tuning, RLHF, tool use, reasoning, agents, and multimodal, etc.

The ideal candidate is a strategic problem-solver with deep expertise in US labor laws, taxation, and ADP+Workday payroll systems.

You will:

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking an Internal Communications Manager to serve as a dedicated communications partner to our Product organization.

Internal communications at Anthropic is not a support function that plans meetings and sends newsletters. The best people in this role operate like advisors who embed themselves deeply in the orgs they support, earn a seat at the leadership table, write on behalf of executives, and see around corners, anticipating what the organization will need to hear before anyone asks for it. There are traditional elements to the role too, like all-hands planning and org change announcements, and you'll run those with operational excellence. For much of the company, it can be hard to keep up with what's shipping, what's changing, and why it matters. Your job is to help people make sense of that pace by understanding the work, and the people doing it, well enough to tell its story credibly, and to help its leaders communicate with clarity and candor as the company scales.
